content.value: A Iartnell governor having a central sleeve spring and two right-angled bell crank levers moves between 300rpm and 320 rpm for a sleeve lift of 15 mm. The sleeve arms and the ball arms are 80 mm and 120 mm respectively. The levers are pivoted at 120 mm from the governor axis and mass of eaćh ball is 2.5 kg. The ball arms are parallel to the governor axis at the lowest equilibrium speed. Determine: (i) loads on the spring at the lowest and the highest equilibrium speeds and (ii) stiffness of the spring.
